summary: PDS Biotechnology filed an 8-K disclosing a September 7, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with accredited investors for an unregistered private placement of common stock and warrants, structured in an initial closing and contingent milestone closing. Initial units price at $0.2825 per share plus a half-warrant; pre-funded warrant units at $0.28217. Aggregate gross proceeds are approximately $11.55 million, with about 20.88 million shares, 20.01 million pre-funded warrants and 20.44 million common warrants expected at the initial closing on or about September 11, 2026, subject to a 19.9% beneficial ownership cap. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
